description: Check a space document the way the app reads it, before anyone saves it. Returns valid:true with `notes`, or an error (code space-invalid) whose `issues` name each problem by JSON path: a modifiedAt that is not epoch milliseconds, a field of the wrong type, a section that would not load, an unknown filter type, operator or sort field, a duplicate section id. Read-only; writes nothing.

document.description:
The space document: a JSON object, or its text exactly as it would be
saved under `TaskForge/Settings/spaces/`.

name: validate_space
